items.title: Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics
items.description: The strongest base for engineering, medicine and technical degrees.
items.details: PCM combines three rigorous subjects with strong mathematical reasoning. Learners study mechanics, fields and waves in Physics; organic, inorganic and physical Chemistry; and pure Mathematics with statistics — ideal preparation for engineering, medicine and research degrees.
items.careers: Engineering, medicine, pharmacy, research, data science, aviation
items.keywords: pcm physics chemistry mathematics engineering mechanics calculus statistics technical science

items.title: Physics, Chemistry & Biology
items.description: A health and life-sciences pathway built on three advanced sciences.
items.details: PCB focuses on the living world alongside physical science. Learners explore human biology, genetics and ecology, supported by Chemistry and Physics practicals, building a strong foundation for medicine, nursing, biomedical and environmental courses.
items.careers: Medicine, nursing, biomedical science, agriculture, environmental health
items.keywords: pcb physics chemistry biology medicine nursing health life science laboratory

items.title: Chemistry, Biology & Geography
items.description: Laboratory science combined with environment, place and fieldwork.
items.details: CBG links laboratory science with the study of people and place. Chemistry and Biology practicals sit alongside physical and human Geography, with field observation, mapping and case studies of development.
items.careers: Medicine, pharmacy, environmental management, agriculture, tourism, urban planning
items.keywords: cbg chemistry biology geography environment fieldwork health agriculture mapping

items.title: Physics, Geography & Mathematics
items.description: Measurement, modelling and a geographical view of the world.
items.details: PGM suits learners who enjoy modelling, measurement and real-world problem solving. Physics and Mathematics develop analytical skill while Geography adds fieldwork, mapping and an understanding of environment and development.
items.careers: Surveying, engineering, GIS, meteorology, urban planning, data analysis
items.keywords: pgm physics geography mathematics surveying gis meteorology engineering data
